sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain in a strong position and will be heavy favourites against Alsager, who sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and arrive in poor form (W-L-L-L-L-L).
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to keep pace with Sandbach after their own recent loss. AFC Bridgnorth welcome mid-table Eccleshall in a fixture between two sides in reasonable form. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth in the table, visit Wednesfield Community, then play Brereton Social on Wednesday evening in a midweek clash. Bilston Town travel to Foley Meir in a meeting of mid-table sides, while Barnton face New Mills at home. Higher up, Eccleshall visit AFC Bridgnorth. Cheadle Heath Nomads, struggling near the bottom, host Telford Town—another side in poor form. Crewe welcome Allscott Heath in a battle of sides near the lower reaches of the table. Shawbury United, in poor form (six losses on the spin), host Barnton. Market Drayton Town travel to face New Mills. Brereton Social, winless in their last three, start at home to Widnes Town before the midweek trip to face Wolverhampton Casuals.
